labels.label: T-abs-two-piece-hoist/two-piece
questions: Reading taken: the witness timelikeLine_twoPiece moved with the section. The dispatch's list names only the section's declarations, but the target's evidence says the witness 'moves with the section if it uses nothing of PieceChart; the closer says which'. It uses nothing of PieceChart (nor Crossing nor CauchySide). Its statement and proof read only TwoPiece's constructor, timelikeLine, timelikeLine_le and timelikeLine_absolutelyMinimalOn (Causal.Lines, ETT-layer, in the closure of Causal.CurveComponents). So it moved, byte for byte, into a section Witness at the end of Causal.TwoPiece. Its docstring still names isCompact_diamond_mixed, which stays in Ppcm. That is a reference to a downstream name in prose only, kept so that the move is byte for byte. The other two witnesses of Ppcm's section Witness stay there, because they read CauchySide or PieceChart: timelikeLine_cauchySide and timelikeLine_twoPiece_globallyHyperbolic. If the author wants the witness back in Ppcm, the move reverses with no other change, because no name changes.
Reading taken: the section's header comment '/-! ### Two pieces: … -/' (Ppcm HEAD :215) moved with the section. It is section-level prose and describes nothing that is left in Ppcm.

new_modules.Causal.TwoPiece: 297 lines, ETT layer. Its only import is Causal.CurveComponents, which brings Causal.Cauchy (IsCauchySurfaceOn, IsCauchySurface), Causal.Generated (AbsolutelyMinimalOn) and Causal.Lines (timelikeLine). These are the only modules whose declarations the moved text uses beyond the Causality core. The module keeps Ppcm's scope lines: namespace Causal, open Set Topology Filter Function TopologicalSpace, universe u, namespace Causality. So the moved declarations keep their universe parameter u (kb/0255) and their elaboration context. Its module docstring follows kb/0006. It has a title and marks no label. It cites, unmarked, prop:ppcm_Cauchy (ETT.tex:1994; the « singular flat spacetime » claim at :2324) and Sbierski Thm 2.7 (mghdthm:CommonExtension, Maximal_GHD2.tex:411, step 4 at :767-769, quoted verbatim). It states the provenance 'Moved from Causal.CBG.Ppcm by T-abs-two-piece-hoist', and has What is proved, a Hypothesis checklist against Sbierski's step 4, SCOPE and Provenance. The moved text is HEAD Ppcm :215-401 at TwoPiece.lean :77-263 and HEAD Ppcm :1306-1328 at :269-291, byte-identical (checked by substring match against `git show HEAD:`).

layer.definition: As in the previous hoists. A strict module is ETT-layer when no module of its transitive import closure, itself included, is in tools/ladder.py's MODEL_LAYER: Causal.Minkowski, Causal.Static, Causal.SingularFlat, Causal.Flat.*, Causal.Model.*, Causal.Port.*. Computed in memory with ladder.lean_index() and ladder.model_path (kb/0247), and with no emit-lean (kb/0252).
